messages:
harper: Quick run-through on the private offer renewal path for the HW+Marketplace bundle. Need to lock renewal discount mechanics, SI success credits, and co-announce timing. EOW sign-off if possible.

noah: Two asks from GTM: (1) avoid surprises in renewal pricing communications, (2) let field auto-generate renewal quotes with pre-approved credits.

sylvia: For renewals, propose a two-stage offer: auto-renew baseline at current committed tier with a 60-day opt-out, plus a promotional upgrade window (30 days) where customers can move to a higher commit tier and receive retroactive credit for past 3 months.

dan: SI economics: suggest splitting onboarding credit into a $7k upfront credit and a $3k delivery milestone tied to usage activation. Cap 3 credits per SI per quarter. Keep credits invoice-applied only.

harper: Finance wants inflation/currency guard for customers billed in EUR/GBP. Proposal: list SKU in USD with FX collar +/-3% and pass-through adjustments on renewal quote only. Ops — feasible?

sylvia: Marketplace ops: two notes: (a) most marketplaces don't support dynamic FX collars in listing; we can surface in private-offer terms only, (b) SKU naming must be static. We'll include FX language in the PO PDF.

noah: For customer-facing language, avoid terms like "penalty." Use "post-commit consumption adjustment" and show a worked example. Field requests include a sample calculator spreadsheet.

dan: Also recommend an internal playbook: when renewal shortfall >15%, trigger AE+CS review before auto-adjustment. That reduces churn risk.

sylvia: Legal-bot, can you draft the minimal PO language for: retro-credit on upgrade, FX collar note, SI credit caps, and renewal opt-out mechanics?

legal-bot: created_draft: "PO Renewal Addendum - HW Marketplace Bundle". Draft ID: RA-9021. Due: 2024-09-05. Assigned: legal: sylvia, harper.

harper: Marketing wants co-announcement freeze 12 business days pre-listing and one pagers for field 5 days pre-listing. Timeline check: pilot end 2024-08-15, listing 2024-09-01. Are dates ok?

noah: Timeline ok. I need 6 localizable slide templates and a sample renewal quote email by 2024-08-20.

dan: Action items:
- sylvia: post PO redline draft RA-9021 to ticket and confirm marketplace field constraints by 2024-08-05
- harper: produce sample renewal calculator and worked example by 2024-08-12
- noah: create AE renewal quote template and local decks by 2024-08-20
- dan: draft SI credit claim flow and caps doc by 2024-08-10

sylvia: One more policy: unused onboarding credits expire at renewal and may convert to a one-time renewal discount only if customer opts into renewal within 45 days. That avoids indefinite liabilities.

harper: Agreed. We'll include explicit consent in renewal UX. I'll coordinate with product on the checkbox wording.

noah: FYI to field: example language for customer emails should be reviewed by legal before sending.

dan: ping legal-bot to escalate RA-9021 if we miss the 2024-08-05 marketplace check.

legal-bot: reminder_set: Draft RA-9021 reminder on 2024-08-04.

harper: Thanks team ":wave:" I'll compile the pilot brief and circulate before EOD.
